programs.title: A8 - Abenteuer Autobahn
programs.desc: For the third time we will have the opportunity to look at German expressways.This time, the creators of the program take us from the A2 motorway to the A8 motorway.The 505-kilometer route starts in Perl, passes through Karlsruhe, Stuttgart, Augsburg and Munich, reaching all the way to the border with Austria.This road is one of the most important East-West connections in Central Europe.We will be able to see the work of the police, truck drivers, highway maintenance services, and engineers whose task is to smooth traffic.
